patch.summary: Fastmail cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Fastmail pricing is plan-gated across 4 researched tiers. No free plan confirmed in SoftwareGlimpse research. 30-day trial documented. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.
bullets: Free plan: not confirmed in SG data

blocks.heading: Fastmail cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Fastmail against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Scope a time-boxed pilot; 30-day trial documented.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (shared inbox) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Not a business phone, WhatsApp or team-chat product — adjacent to business communications. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Small teams that want private, independent business email on their own domain requires a paid unlock you will use weekly
Do not overbuy if this limitation dominates: Not a business phone, WhatsApp or team-chat product — adjacent to business communications
Side-by-side cost with SaneBox on the same seat count

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: Not a business phone, WhatsApp or team-chat product — adjacent to business communications

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Shared addresses, shared calendars and the shared address book require Standard or above

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Basic is capped at 5 GB mail and 1 GB file storage

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: No CRM/CTI logging, call analytics or conversation reporting

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: No AI assistance documented in the published plans

blocks.title: Cheaper or clearer alternatives to pressure-test
blocks.body: Compare total cost of ownership vs Fastmail on identical constraints.

blocks.body: Use researched plan structure for Fastmail alongside category cost modelling.
